shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; find .agents -type f

sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ------; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ------; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head;
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text Card Flex Container Row Col ThemeProvider Icon

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; grep -n -i -A8 "page-constructor" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | sed -n 1,80p; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui
npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor @diplodoc/transform 2>&1 | tail -15; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && grep '"version"' package.json; grep -m1 '"version"' ../uikit/package.json; cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -80; ls build/docs/blocks build/docs/guides

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs && cat blocks/Header.md | head -120; echo =======; sed -n 1,70p blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md; echo ======; sed -n 1,70p blocks/Banner.md
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm install -D sass vite-plugin-dynamic-import 2>&1 | grep -E "added|ERR|error" ; git status --short; cat package.json | sed -n 8,30p
sed -i 's#/^~(@diplodoc\\/)/#/^~(@(?:diplodoc|gravity-ui)\\/)/#' vite.config.ts && grep alias -A1 vite.config.ts && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -15
npx vite build 2>&1 | grep -v "^    at" | head -20; ls node_modules/url 2>/dev/null | head -3

npm install url 2>&1 | grep -E "added|ERR" ; python3 -I - <<'EOF'
p='vite.config.ts'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("alias: [{ find:", "alias: [\n      { find: /^url$/, replacement: 'url/' }, // page-constructor imports Node's `url` in browser code\n      { find:")
s=s.replace("'$1' }],","'$1' },\n    ],")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat vite.config.ts; npx tsc --noEmit && npx vite build 2>&1 | grep -v -i -E "deprecat|^$|sass-lang|│|╷|╵|root stylesheet|More info|^\s+node_modules" | tail -20
